id: 5b4e1a8c-7c19-4d62-9c2f-8a3e9d7c0d11
description: Detects inbound email impersonating Microsoft account security alerts (OTP / abnormal activity lures) carrying a ZIP attachment — the APT37 NarwhalRAT delivery shape.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/fake-microsoft-alerts-used-to-deploy.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  product: m365
  service: threat_management
detection:
  selection:
    EventType: 'EmailEvents'
    EmailDirection: 'Inbound'
    DeliveryAction:
      - 'Delivered'
      - 'DeliveredAsSpam'
  subject_terms:
    Subject|contains:
      - 'Microsoft account'
      - 'OTP'
      - 'one-time password'
      - 'abnormal activity'
      - 'account compromise'
      - 'security alert'
      - 'unusual sign-in'
  attachment:
    FileName|endswith: '.zip'
  condition: selection and subject_terms and attachment
level: high
2487.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Email where Email.file_name="*.lnk" Email.message_direction="inbound" by Email.src_user Email.recipient Email.subject Email.file_name Email.file_hash Email.message_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Email)` | search subject IN ("*Microsoft*account*","*OTP*","*one-time*password*","*security alert*","*abnormal activity*","*account compromise*") AND file_name="*.lnk"

id: 9af2d4e7-1b6f-49d0-93b1-7c5e1a3d4f88
description: Detects schtasks/PowerShell scheduled-task creation with the Microsoft[Word]TaskMachine naming convention used by APT37 to deploy NarwhalRAT and the related Python-loader chain.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/fake-microsoft-alerts-used-to-deploy.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.t1053.005
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows

    - Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    - CommandLine|contains:
        - 'schtasks /create'
        - 'Register-ScheduledTask'
        - 'New-ScheduledTask'
  selection_name:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'MicrosoftUserInterfacePicturesUpdateTackMachine'
      - 'MicrosoftMusicLibrariesPackageTaskMachine'
      - 'MicrosoftUserInterfacePictures'
      - 'MicrosoftMusicLibrariesPackage'
  condition: selection_creator and selection_name
level: high
